stage.name: s2_5_actor
stage.notes: hands (pick, hold, eat; the pallium reads the item in hand) and the basal ganglia's actor: Go and NoGo channels for USE and EAT learned from dopamine, credit by an efference copy; the poison bushes have thorns (a pick from one costs food and pricks); control the critic brain with hands

no_plasticity.why: how much of the fitness needs learning within a life

no_feed.why: the old aversion to what is seen, now on EAT: help or hindrance

grasp.why: the old appetite for what is seen, now on EAT: help or hindrance

pallium.why: the code that the critic and the actor read

no_eat.why: aversion to the held berry stopping it from being eaten

act.why: the actor's drive onto USE and EAT: does the creature lean on it

learn_off:striatum_d1.why: the actor's Go learning (release what paid off): is it used

learn_off:striatum_d2.why: the actor's NoGo learning (hold back what hurt): is it used
